cadence_policy: Preserve every local tick/reset/RNG. Aggregate after ticks divisible by k; broadcast before first tick and after each aggregation including final deployment. Local states continue between aggregations.
central_role: Contextual engineered-example pooling comparator: same examples/epochs,8460 versus9000 Adam steps. Declared upload: unscaled TRAIN x/climate float64, rainfall labels float64, and per-client count int64. Server reconstructs TRAIN target scaling/q80 and shared input scaling, so there is no extra scaler upload. Unused drivers need not be transmitted. Overlapping windows duplicate source information; payload is for this example representation, not minimum original-product raw bytes. Model deployment downlink is counted. No universal bandwidth/privacy ordering is claimed.
costs: Logical uncompressed numeric payload, sum of all uplinks/downlinks including final global deployment. Seed/architecture installation assumed common. Excludes transport/encryption and research audit exports; those are reported separately. Inactive CAAA performance/climate aggregation telemetry and server sensitivity upload are omitted; adaptive proximal sensitivity remains local. No measured WAN, energy or privacy guarantee.

fixed_budget.optimizer: Adam reset every tick; deterministic paired client/tick RNG

interpretation_limits: Five overlapping public geoboxes, one CPU host; no independent institutional deployment.
Local-normalization federation also changes parameter coordinate alignment; not pure information gain.
Common schema/architecture/seed installation assumes prior coordination.
Unknown2025exposure is not used as an untouched holdout.
Revised archives do not authenticate historical release vintages.
Communication cadence and local normalization are existing ideas; case-specific evidence is not new algorithm novelty.
preprocessing: Input mean/std from TRAIN origin rows only. Shared arm uploads count/int64 plus sum and squared sum/float64, then broadcasts mean/std. Local target stats/q80 always stay local for distributed training.

status: Exploratory extension: 2017-2024 was inspected previously. This freeze is before new fits, not preregistration before all outcome exposure.

uncertainty.tests: Exact annual sign flips of paired squared-loss contributions; 8 annual blocks, two-sided, Holm family7. Annual exchangeability is an assumption; not a population-of-institutions test.

validation_policy: No validation feedback changes fitting or final endpoint. Round-wise validation is a separate research audit. Secondary earliest best common macro-VAL checkpoint among ticks20/40/60 includes explicitly priced summary/selection sharing; no EVAL-based selection.
